I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to him was November 3, 2025.

That date comes from Moss's Nov 2 Coastal digest, which says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap agrees. I told Kwame to use Nov 3 as the official date in the CRM. If the CRM has an operational-start field, use Nov 22. Bettina ran the day-to-day until Nov 21, and Kwame took over fully on Nov 22.

Both sources are in #coastal-team or public files, and Kwame is a member of #coastal-team.
